notes: s005 πιστεύοντι takes a bare *believeth*: the ASV continues the relative clause opened at s004 without writing a second relativizer, so rule 32 leaves the participle only its own verb.
s013 ἡ is unrepresented under rule 20, the genitive αὐτοῦ carrying *his*; contrast ROM.4.9, where no possessor stands and the article takes the supplied possessive itself.
